baseline: Historical lead fracture rate per 1000 device-years
conditions: Device implantation in patients with a history of high-impact or high-frequency cardiac motion (e.g., athletes or patients with severe arrhythmias)
falsifier: No significant decrease in lead fracture rate per 1000 device-years within the first 2 years post-implantation, or a lead fracture rate exceeding 20% per 1000 device-years within the first 5 years post-implantation
